description: Build the site's stored editable source in an isolated one-shot build pod and atomically publish the output as the live site, replacing the served files (a restore point is normally taken first). Use build_and_deploy after changing stored source (write_source_files, apply_edits with target 'source'); use update_site instead to upload files that are already built. The first build saves buildCommand, outputDir and rootPath on the site, so later calls can omit them. A failed build returns its log in the error details.

buildCommand.description: Build command override, e.g. 'npm run build:prod' or 'pnpm vite build'. Default: the saved manifest, then 'npm run build'.

name.description: Site name as shown by list_sites, e.g. my-portfolio. Provide name or siteId.

outputDir.description: Directory to publish. Default: the saved manifest, then auto-detect (dist > build > out > public).

rootPath.description: Subdirectory of the source tree that holds package.json (monorepos). Empty string = source root.

saveManifest.description: Default true: save these settings on the site for later builds. false = one-off build.

siteId.description: Site id from list_sites or get_site. Use instead of name.

name: build_and_deploy

buildLog.description: Combined orchestrator + builder log; truncated to ~32 KB to fit MCP responses.

manageUrl.description: Dashboard page where the user manages this site (domains, versions, settings).

title: Build editable source and ship the result as the new dist
